firstUserMessage: I want to add a custom view to the "勤怠管理" collection. Ask me what I want to see or edit, then author the HTML view file at data/skills/kintai/views/your-view.html and register it in data/skills/kintai/schema.json under `views[]` (capabilities ["read"] for a read-only view, ["read","write"] if it edits records). Follow the custom-view help for the data contract.
